runtime: Offline JavaScript, float32 arrays, Web Workers; no external runtime libraries

exactFeatures.targetRecurrence: h(p) = [6*h(2p) + sum(count[s]*h(p+s))]/36, h(p>=target)=1; bust contribution is zero
exactFeatures.largerTargets: Integer grid lower/upper bounds, approximately 512 cells
exactFeatures.scoreArithmetic: Safe integer Number, then BigInt promotion
ruleOverrides: Two-player strict-lead preservation by public bank matching
Final-round strict-lead shadowing with one active rival

training.reward: Terminal first place 1, k-way tie 1/k, otherwise 0
training.earlyStop: Minibatch mean oldLogProbability-newLogProbability over non-forced actions > 0.04
training.exactActionTreatment: Masked PPO/entropy; value and auxiliary teacher learning retained
training.selfPlay: 50% all current network; remaining mixed current, scripted, saved networks
training.parallelism: One learner; remaining selected workers collect full games using frozen batch weights; max six workers total
training.checkpoint: Weights, Adam moments/step, league, config, last evaluation in IndexedDB

evaluation.opponents: Fresh seeds and lineups from training scripted families
evaluation.reference: Existing heuristic fallback, paired seed/opponent lineup
evaluation.notIncluded: Full old-engine tournament, human validation, statistical strength proof

status: Experimental. Untrained by default. Demonstration checkpoint is optional and insufficient to establish strength.
